LESSON: HADITH ON GOOD BEHAVIOUR

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Hadith
Topic 2.1: Hadith on good Behaviour

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Hadith on good Behaviour. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why should one behave well?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify examples of good behaviour from the selected Hadith for character building
2. discuss the significance of the selected Hadith in shaping the character of a Muslim
3. apply good behaviour in day-to-day life
4. appreciate the teachings of the Hadith by applying them in day-to- day life

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: HADITH ON GOOD BEHAVIOUR
This lesson teaches Hadith on good Behaviour for Grade 5 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify examples of good behaviour from the selected Hadith for character building
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. discuss the significance of the selected Hadith in shaping the character of a Muslim
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. apply good behaviour in day-to-day life
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
4. appreciate the teachings of the Hadith by applying them in day-to- day life
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Hadith on good Behaviour using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Hadith on good Behaviour above.
2. Explain Hadith on good Behaviour to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Hadith on good Behaviour.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Hadith on good Behaviour with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Hadith on good Behaviour important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should one behave well?
2. What actions show that you fear Allah?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify examples of good behaviour from the selected Hadith for character building
2. discuss the significance of the selected Hadith in shaping the character of a Muslim
3. apply good behaviour in day-to-day life
4. appreciate the teachings of the Hadith by applying them in day-to- day life

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
